title: Monotonicity of circuit size bounds
statement: For functions $T,T' : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and a language $L$ over Boolean strings, if $L$ is recognized by a family of fan-in-two Boolean circuits whose size on inputs of length $n$ is at most $T(n)$ for every $n$, and $T(n) \leq T'(n)$ for every $n$, then $L$ is recognized by a family of fan-in-two Boolean circuits whose size on inputs of length $n$ is at most $T'(n)$ for every $n$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ belongs to the size class with bound $T$
